objective: Grow qualified Cove private-beta waitlist joins in the United Kingdom via Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, using owned landers and campaign creatives, without live account mutation until mutation gates pass

channels.rationale: Strong fit for Mac-owner problem/solution creative (own-drive and out-of-space narratives) and waitlist CTA creatives; Instagram/Facebook placements match existing od-* and jl-* PNG kits. Cold-start: treat account, Pixel, and conversion history as unknown until evidence exists; no mature-account CPA or Advantage+ consolidation claims.
prerequisites: Meta Business Manager ad account ID configured in setup-profile
Meta Pixel or Conversions API events for Waitlist Joined with diagnostics
Approved GBP budget ceiling and target cost per waitlist join
Creative rights confirmed for public/campaign/own-drive and join-the-list
exclusions: No live campaign creation or budget edits in this plan
No broad negatives or lookalike claims without seed evidence
Do not optimize to link clicks as a proxy for waitlist joins

channels.rationale: Search captures explicit Mac storage / cloud-drive / Finder-mount intent; Demand Gen or YouTube can reuse product imagery later. Separate YouTube score if YouTube is activated. Provisional until keyword demand and conversion tagging are evidenced.
prerequisites: Google tag + conversion action for waitlist join (and Enhanced Conversions if eligible)
Approved search themes derived from site copy only after Search Terms review policy is accepted
Landing pages indexable and fast on mobile and desktop
Approved GBP budget and CPA band
exclusions: No invented negative keyword list without a search terms report
Do not sum Meta and Google conversions across mismatched windows
No Performance Max scale claims without feed/asset and conversion history
No live account writes from this plan

channels.rationale: Cove desks include Marketing and Building with agents; LinkedIn creatives (od-li-*, jl-li-*) already exist. Use for professional Mac users and small teams, not mass consumer scale. Keep budgets provisional and audiences narrow until Insight Tag and lead quality are reviewed.
prerequisites: LinkedIn Campaign Manager account ID configured
LinkedIn Insight Tag on waitlist thank-you / join confirmation path
Approved professional audience hypotheses (marketing, creative studios, agent builders)
Approved GBP budget and CPA band
exclusions: No job-title scraping or unapproved matched audiences
No Mt. Mtn. enterprise pitch mixed into founding-beta waitlist ads without separate offer approval
No live campaign mutation from this plan

actions.description: Operator records monthly GBP paid budget ceiling and target (or band) cost per waitlist join in setup notes
actions.timing: before any launch draft with spend
actions.success_measure: Setup profile or operator note contains currency GBP, monthly ceiling, and target CPA band
actions.rollback_or_exit: Keep budgets null and stop before /ads launch --apply

actions.description: Replace Meta, Google, and LinkedIn account_id placeholders; store API tokens only in environment or keychain with secret_ref in profile
actions.success_measure: setup-profile account_refs show real IDs; secret presence refs only
actions.rollback_or_exit: Leave unconfigured; continue advisory creative work only

actions.description: Map POST /api/waitlist success to platform conversion events (Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google conversion, LinkedIn conversion) with UTM capture already on site
actions.success_measure: Test events fire for Waitlist Joined in each platform diagnostics; cold-start dimensions classified
actions.rollback_or_exit: Pause launch drafts if events missing or mis-attributed

actions.description: Approve or reject pending tone and primary_audiences inferences on brand-profile
actions.success_measure: approval_status approved or rejected with note

actions.description: Run /ads create for Meta feed and story using public/campaign/own-drive and join-the-list PNGs; primary lander /land/own-drive, convert on /land/join-the-list
actions.success_measure: Schema-valid creative-brief under a new run with human_review pending
actions.rollback_or_exit: Do not upload creatives to Meta until human_review approved

actions.description: Draft Google Search RSA themes from approved site claims only (Mac cloud drive, Finder mount, private beta waitlist); Demand Gen asset list from own-drive kit as optional phase-2
actions.success_measure: Copy deck with approved_claims evidence_refs; no negatives invented
actions.rollback_or_exit: Hold Search launch if claims or conversion action unapproved

actions.description: Run /ads create for LinkedIn single image using od-li-* and jl-li-* assets aimed at marketing and agent-builder desks
actions.timing: parallel with Meta creative after brand review
actions.success_measure: Schema-valid creative-brief; audience hypotheses labeled provisional
actions.rollback_or_exit: Do not enable LinkedIn spend without Insight Tag validation

actions.description: Produce /ads launch --draft for Meta: one prospecting campaign to /land/own-drive or /land/stays-light and one conversion campaign to /land/join-the-list; cold-start staging only
actions.success_measure: mutation-plan status draft with ceilings, rollback, verification steps
actions.rollback_or_exit: Never --apply until owner approval and mutation gate pass

actions.description: Produce /ads launch --draft for Google Search waitlist acquisition with exact conversion action and lander /land/join-the-list (or own-drive→list path)
actions.success_measure: mutation-plan draft with search structure and measurement checks
actions.rollback_or_exit: No apply; pause if search terms evidence later shows policy risk

actions.description: Produce /ads launch --draft for LinkedIn sponsored content waitlist with narrow professional targeting hypotheses
actions.rollback_or_exit: No apply; exit if CPL exceeds approved band after learning window

actions.description: After first live spend (post-approval), review same-window waitlist joins vs platform-reported conversions; do not sum mismatched attribution windows
actions.timing: 7 to 14 days after first approved spend
actions.success_measure: Reconciled join count from waitlist store vs platform conversions with disclosed gaps
actions.rollback_or_exit: Pause underperforming channel drafts or live campaigns via approved mutation plans only

assumptions: Primary geography is United Kingdom; other English-speaking markets remain provisional
Primary conversion is waitlist join, not download (publicRelease false)
Owned creatives under public/campaign are rights-cleared for Cove paid use
Meta account, Pixel, and conversion history are unknown cold-start dimensions until evidenced
Budget amounts stay null until operator supplies GBP ceilings
British English and no em dashes in public ad copy
exclusions: No live account writes or spend from this plan
No /ads audit until dated platform exports or API reads exist
No invented CPA/ROAS targets or channel mix percentages
No negative keyword list without search terms evidence
TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, X, Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, YouTube not in scope for this plan

retention.purpose: Advisory Cove waitlist media plan and status-next artifacts; no credentials or account exports

deletion.method: Operator deletes this run directory after review or when superseded
